sql: SELECT * FROM employee WHERE salary > 100000;
SELECT * FROM employee WHERE salary BETWEEN 100000 AND 200000;
SELECT * FROM project WHERE site = 'pune';
SELECT * FROM employee WHERE dept_no = 5;
SELECT * FROM dependent WHERE relationship = 'spouse';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee;
SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employee;
SELECT SUM(hours) FROM assignment;
SELECT dept_no, COUNT(*) FROM employee GROUP BY dept_no;
SELECT dept_no, COUNT(*) FROM project GROUP BY dept_no;
SELECT relationship, COUNT(*) FROM dependent GROUP BY relationship;
SELECT project_no, SUM(hours) AS total_hours FROM assignment GROUP BY project_no;
SELECT * FROM employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM department ORDER BY dept_name ASC;
SELECT * FROM employee ORDER BY birth_date ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT * FROM dependent JOIN employee ON dependent.emp_id = employee.emp_id;
SELECT * FROM employee JOIN department ON employee.dept_no = department.dept_no;
SELECT e.first_name, e.middle_initial, e.last_name FROM employee e JOIN assignment a ON e.emp_id = a.emp_id JOIN project p ON a.project_no = p.project_no WHERE p.project_name = 'Atlas';
SELECT e.emp_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, p.project_name FROM employee e JOIN assignment a ON e.emp_id = a.emp_id JOIN project p ON a.project_no = p.project_no;

SELECT d.dependent_name, d.gender, d.birth_date, d.relationship FROM dependent d JOIN employee e ON d.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN assignment a ON e.emp_id = a.emp_id JOIN project p ON a.project_no = p.project_no WHERE p.project_name = 'Atlas';
SELECT e.emp_id, e.first_name, e.middle_initial, e.last_name FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON e.manager_id = m.emp_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Kavita' AND m.last_name = 'Rao';
SELECT manager_id, COUNT(emp_id) AS num_employees FROM employee GROUP BY manager_id;
SELECT employee.* FROM employee LEFT JOIN dependent ON employee.emp_id = dependent.emp_id WHERE dependent.emp_id IS NULL;
SELECT * FROM employee WHERE emp_id = 'E1001';
SELECT * FROM employee WHERE YEAR(birth_date) > 1965;
SELECT * FROM employee WHERE birth_date >= '1966-01-01';
